categories.summary: No extensibility surface: no plugin system, no scripting/macro language, no public/automation API. The console offers raw GRBL command entry plus a fixed, driver-defined set of quick-command buttons (not user-savable macros). The only 'extension' points are file formats: .lf2 projects, .lfml.json material libraries (import/export), .lbdev device-profile import, and SVG/DXF/STL in, SVG/G-code out. No user-defined macros or headless/CLI interface.

evidence.cite: grep of src for plugin|scripting|user-script|extension api = no plugin/scripting/API implementation; package.json has no plugin/scripting infrastructure
